title: Modern Glass Coffee Table Sculptural Wood Base
desc:
Bring a refined modern statement into your living space with this sculptural glass coffee table, thoughtfully designed to blend minimalist elegance with artistic form. Featuring a sleek tempered glass top balanced between a smooth stone-inspired sphere and a rich natural wood base, this piece creates a striking visual balance that feels both contemporary and timeless.

Crafted with premium materials and a clean architectural silhouette, this table is designed to become the focal point of any living room, lounge, office, or luxury interior. The transparent glass surface keeps the space feeling open and airy, while the warm wood grain adds natural texture and sophistication. The sculptural sphere support introduces an artistic touch that transforms this functional furniture piece into a modern décor statement.

Perfect for modern, minimalist, Japandi, contemporary, and luxury-inspired interiors, this coffee table offers both style and practicality. The spacious glass surface is ideal for displaying books, candles, decorative objects, or serving guests while maintaining a refined uncluttered appearance.

Its handcrafted-inspired construction and unique mixed-material composition make every piece visually distinctive and elegant for modern homes.

Care Instructions:
Wipe the glass with a soft microfiber cloth and gentle glass cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive materials on the wood and decorative sphere. Clean spills promptly to maintain the beauty of the finish.

Add this sculptural centerpiece to your home and elevate your interior with modern artistic elegance.

• Craft Technique: Modern Handcrafted Construction

desc:
Elevate your interior with the timeless beauty of this green marble side table, designed to bring sculptural elegance and natural luxury into your home. The deep green marble surface showcases unique natural patterns, making every table one of a kind. Its cylindrical ribbed base adds texture and visual depth while maintaining a clean modern silhouette that blends beautifully into contemporary, minimalist, organic modern, and luxury interiors.

Perfect as a side table, accent table, bedside table, or decorative pedestal, this versatile piece works beautifully beside sofas, lounge chairs, or beds. The polished marble finish reflects light softly, adding warmth and refinement to any room while creating a durable surface for décor, books, candles, or floral arrangements.

Crafted with attention to detail and timeless styling, this marble table offers both functionality and artistic presence for modern living spaces.
